idea.title: Show HN: Forgot the Command? Stay in the Terminal
idea.description: Show HN: Forgot the Command? Stay in the Terminal - This idea involves creating a terminal emulator that stays in the foreground even when the user is not actively using it, making it easier to run and manage commands without having to switch between applications.
